_about: Reader errors and refused variants found by held-out draw D (docs/benchmark/heldout-2026-10-06d.md), for assignment. Do not develop or debug on these files: reproduce each finding on a NEW public file, add that file to the development corpus with its own provenance entry, and let the held-out file confirm the fix afterwards (docs/benchmark/heldout.md, rule 2). 'expected' comes from the third-party reader or depositor export named in 'evidence'; 'got' is OpenReadout 0.1.0 at main 572e5922 (release build). Severity: high = data missing or wrong silently, or an intact file rejected, on a mainstream instrument; medium = a wrong or missing value an agent would report; low = metadata, precision or a false integrity alarm; gap = a variant refused with a hint.
